opennyai_summary.final__decision:
The learned counsels for the respondent(s) submit that by the Notification dated 10.11.2020, the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India has initiated the consultation process under Section 92 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
They further submit, on instructions,
that the Impugned Notification/Direction dated 23.09.2020 has been withdrawn by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India.
All consequent orders issued thereon be also treated as withdrawn.
In view of the above, the petitions stand satisfied and are disposed of recording the above statement."
In view of the aforesaid, the petition is disposed of.
